note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Small dark speckles and dark fringe dots appear along the outer right edge of the bowl and tail in the 128px result, a sharpening halo artifact from the luminance clamp-sharpen step.
flags.fix: Lower the clamp-sharpen strength on glyph edges or clamp the sharpen so it cannot push pixels darker than the local background; re-check the outline for dark dots.

flags.problem: Same dark speckle and dark fringe dots along the leg and bowl edges of the R, from the glyph-edge clamp-sharpen step; the 1:1 crop is otherwise clean.
flags.fix: Same as q: reduce or clamp the edge sharpen so it does not create dark halo dots next to bright strokes.

flags.problem: Statue silhouette and figure are preserved, but the 1:1 centre crop of the sandstone background is a blotchy violet-grey cloud texture with scratch lines and no visible block courses, so it has a cool colour cast against the warm tan original.
flags.fix: Re-run colormatch against the original's local warm tan chroma (or lower the libcrop sandstone weight) so the 1:1 background stays warm tan and keeps the original block rhythm.
